title: DocumentChanged v1
description: A SharePoint document library reported a change. The event names the library, never the document: the consumer asks Graph what changed with a delta query, so a replayed or duplicated event cannot describe stale content.

specVersion.description: Contract version. A consumer rejects what it does not know instead of guessing.

id.description: Deterministic per notification: used to drop duplicates within a visibility window.

library.description: Document library (drive) name, exactly as SharePoint spells it, accents included.

resource.description: Graph resource from the notification, kept for correlation only.
